```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
```


# Aggregating the results from validation experiment

## Loading the gRNA target mapping

```{r}
# Load gRNA target data frame
grna_target_df <- fread(here("results/2026-05-11_SCEPTRE/tables/grna_target_data_frame.tsv"), data.table=FALSE)
num_tested_guides <- nrow(grna_target_df)
num_tested_elements <- length(unique(grna_target_df$grna_target))
num_nt_guides <- sum(grna_target_df$grna_target == "non-targeting")
message("Number of targeting guides: ", num_tested_guides - num_nt_guides)
message("Number of non-targeting guides: ", num_nt_guides)
message("Number of tested elements: ", num_tested_elements - 1) # Because it includes non-targeting as element
```

## Loading paper results

```{r}
table_s3_path <- here("data/Table_S3_Final_DC_TAP_Seq_Results_w_Chromatin_Categories_on_resized_and_merged_elements_250908_append.tsv")
table_s3 <- fread(table_s3_path, data.table=FALSE)
# Filter to WTC11 only (matching analysis)
table_s3_wtc11 <- table_s3[table_s3$cell_type == "WTC11", ]
# Filter to match only the elements in gRNA mapping
tested_elements <- unique(grna_target_df$grna_target)
table_s3_wtc11 <- table_s3_wtc11[table_s3_wtc11$intended_target_name_hg38 %in% tested_elements, ]
number_of_pairs_tested <- dim(table_s3_wtc11)[1]
message("Number of pairs in validation experiment: ", number_of_pairs_tested)
```

# Significant pairs

```{r}
cat("Significant pairs:\n")
sig_pairs <- table_s3_wtc11[table_s3_wtc11$significant == TRUE, ]
cat("  ", nrow(sig_pairs), " (", round(100*nrow(sig_pairs)/nrow(table_s3_wtc11), 2), "% )\n\n")
```


# Breakdown by element category if available

```{r}
# Replace NA with "Other"
table_s3_wtc11$element_category[is.na(table_s3_wtc11$element_category)] <- "Other"
sig_pairs$element_category[is.na(sig_pairs$element_category)] <- "Other"

cat("Pairs by element category (All):\n")
print(table(table_s3_wtc11$element_category))

cat("\nPairs by element category (Significant):\n")
print(table(sig_pairs$element_category))
```

# Plots

```{r}
# Define category order and color map
category_order <- c("High H3K27ac", "H3K27ac", "No H3K27ac", "CTCF element", "H3K27me3 element", "Other")
color_values <- c("#c5373d", "#d9694a", "#c5cad7", "#49bcbc", "#429130", "grey80")
color_map <- setNames(color_values, category_order)
```

## Pairs by element category

```{r}
# Count pairs by category
category_counts <- data.frame(table(table_s3_wtc11$element_category))
names(category_counts) <- c("element_category", "all_pairs")

sig_category_counts <- data.frame(table(sig_pairs$element_category))
names(sig_category_counts) <- c("element_category", "sig_pairs")

category_counts <- merge(category_counts, sig_category_counts, by="element_category", all.x=TRUE)
category_counts$sig_pairs[is.na(category_counts$sig_pairs)] <- 0

# Convert to ordered factor
category_counts$element_category <- factor(category_counts$element_category, levels=category_order)
category_counts <- category_counts[order(category_counts$element_category), ]

# Reshape for plotting
category_long <- data.frame(
  category = rep(category_counts$element_category, 2),
  pairs = c(category_counts$all_pairs, category_counts$sig_pairs),
  type = rep(c("All", "Significant"), each=nrow(category_counts))
)

# Create fill colors: white for "All", color_map for "Significant"
category_long$fill_color <- ifelse(category_long$type == "Significant", 
                                   color_map[as.character(category_long$category)],
                                   "white")

ggplot(category_long, aes(x=category, y=pairs, fill=fill_color)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge", color="black") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_text(aes(label=pairs), position=position_dodge(width=0.9), vjust=-0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="Pairs by Element Category", x="Element Category", y="Number of Pairs") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), legend.position="none")
```

## Effect size by element category

```{r}
table_s3_wtc11_plot <- data.frame(table_s3_wtc11[, c("element_category", "pct_change_effect_size")])
table_s3_wtc11_plot$element_category <- factor(table_s3_wtc11_plot$element_category, levels=category_order)
table_s3_wtc11_plot$significance <- "Non-significant"
table_s3_wtc11_plot$significance[table_s3_wtc11$significant == TRUE] <- "Significant"

# Create fill colors: white for non-significant, color_map for significant
table_s3_wtc11_plot$fill_color <- ifelse(table_s3_wtc11_plot$significance == "Significant",
                                          color_map[as.character(table_s3_wtc11_plot$element_category)],
                                          "white")

# Count points per group
point_counts <- table_s3_wtc11_plot %>%
  group_by(element_category, significance) %>%
  summarise(n=n(), max_y=max(pct_change_effect_size), .groups='drop')
# Add fill_color to point_counts for proper dodging
point_counts$fill_color <- ifelse(point_counts$significance == "Significant",
                                   color_map[as.character(point_counts$element_category)],
                                   "white")

ggplot(table_s3_wtc11_plot, aes(x=element_category, y=pct_change_effect_size, fill=fill_color)) +
  geom_boxplot(color="black") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_text(data=point_counts, aes(x=element_category, y=max_y, label=n, fill=fill_color), vjust=-0.5, color="black", position=position_dodge(width=0.75)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="Effect Size (% Change) by Element Category", x="Element Category", y="% Change") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), legend.position="none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dotted", alpha=0.5)
```

## Distance to TSS by element category

```{r}
table_s3_wtc11_tss <- data.frame(table_s3_wtc11[, c("element_category", "distance_to_gencode_gene_TSS")])
table_s3_wtc11_tss$element_category <- factor(table_s3_wtc11_tss$element_category, levels=category_order)
table_s3_wtc11_tss$distance_kb <- table_s3_wtc11_tss$distance_to_gencode_gene_TSS / 1000
table_s3_wtc11_tss$significance <- "Non-significant"
table_s3_wtc11_tss$significance[table_s3_wtc11$significant == TRUE] <- "Significant"

# Create fill colors: white for non-significant, color_map for significant
table_s3_wtc11_tss$fill_color <- ifelse(table_s3_wtc11_tss$significance == "Significant",
                                         color_map[as.character(table_s3_wtc11_tss$element_category)],
                                         "white")

# Count points per group
point_counts_tss <- table_s3_wtc11_tss %>%
  group_by(element_category, significance) %>%
  summarise(n=n(), max_y=max(distance_kb), .groups='drop')
# Add fill_color to point_counts_tss for proper dodging
point_counts_tss$fill_color <- ifelse(point_counts_tss$significance == "Significant",
                                       color_map[as.character(point_counts_tss$element_category)],
                                       "white")

ggplot(table_s3_wtc11_tss, aes(x=element_category, y=distance_kb, fill=fill_color)) +
  geom_boxplot(color="black") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_text(data=point_counts_tss, aes(x=element_category, y=max_y, label=n, fill=fill_color), vjust=-0.5, color="black", position=position_dodge(width=0.75)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="Distance to GENCODE Gene TSS by Element Category", x="Element Category", y="Distance (kb)") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), legend.position="none") +
  scale_y_log10()
```

# Loading SCEPTRE union results

```{r}
# Load all union discovery results
union_dirs <- c("MOI1_1_union", "MOI1_5_union", "MOI11_3_union", "MOI13_union", 
                "low_moi_merged_union", "high_moi_merged_union")

sceptre_results_list <- list()

for (dir_name in union_dirs) {
  results_path <- here("results/2026-05-11_SCEPTRE/runs", dir_name, "sceptre_discovery_results.tsv")
  if (file.exists(results_path)) {
    sceptre_results <- fread(results_path, data.table=FALSE)
    sceptre_results$source <- dir_name
    sceptre_results_list[[dir_name]] <- sceptre_results
    message("Loaded ", dir_name, ": ", nrow(sceptre_results), " results")
  } else {
    message("WARNING: ", results_path, " not found")
  }
}

# Combine all results
sceptre_results_all <- do.call(rbind, sceptre_results_list)
rownames(sceptre_results_all) <- NULL
sceptre_results_all$pct_change_effect_size <- 100 * (sceptre_results_all$fold_change - 1)
sceptre_results_all$se_change_effect_size <- 100 * sceptre_results_all$se_fold_change
sceptre_results_all$fdr <- p.adjust(sceptre_results_all$p_value, method="fdr")

# Add gene symbols from GENCODE v32 using ENSG response IDs
gencode_v32_path <- here("data/gencode.v32.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
gencode_genes <- fread(
  cmd = paste("gzip -dc", shQuote(gencode_v32_path)),
  sep = "\t",
  header = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  data.table = FALSE,
  fill = TRUE,
  comment.char = "#"
)
colnames(gencode_genes) <- c(
  "seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score",
  "strand", "frame", "attribute"
)
gencode_genes <- gencode_genes[gencode_genes$feature == "gene", "attribute", drop = FALSE]
gencode_genes$gene_id <- sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gencode_genes$attribute)
gencode_genes$gene_symbol <- sub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gencode_genes$attribute)
gencode_genes$gene_id_stripped <- sub("\\..*$", "", gencode_genes$gene_id)
gencode_genes <- unique(gencode_genes[, c("gene_id_stripped", "gene_symbol")])

sceptre_results_all$response_id_stripped <- sub("\\..*$", "", sceptre_results_all$response_id)
sceptre_results_all <- merge(
  sceptre_results_all,
  gencode_genes,
  by.x = "response_id_stripped",
  by.y = "gene_id_stripped",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
sceptre_results_all$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 <- paste(sceptre_results_all$gene_symbol, sceptre_results_all$grna_target, sep="|")

message("Total SCEPTRE results: ", nrow(sceptre_results_all))
message("Unique pairs tested: ", length(unique(paste(sceptre_results_all$response_id, sceptre_results_all$grna_target))))
```

# Results comparison

```{r}
# How many significant pairs are confirmed by the validation experiment?
pairs_mask <- sceptre_results_all$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 %in% sig_pairs$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38
plot_df <- sceptre_results_all %>%
  filter(pairs_mask) %>%
  select(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, pct_change_effect_size, significant, source)

plot_df <- merge(
  plot_df,
  sig_pairs[, c("element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38", "element_category", "pct_change_effect_size")],
  by.x = c("element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38"),
  by.y = c("element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)


plot_df_counts <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(significant) ~ "Not tested",
      significant ~ "Significant",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    significant = factor(
      significant,
      levels = c("Not significant", "Significant", "Not tested")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(source, element_category, significant, name = "n")


ggplot(plot_df_counts,
       aes(x = element_category, y = n, fill = significant)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ source, ncol=2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "DC-TAP paper results validation",
    x = "Element Category",
    y = "Number of pairs",
    fill = NULL
  )
```


```{r height=12}
source_order <- c(
  "MOI1_1_union",
  "MOI1_5_union",
  "low_moi_merged_union",
  "MOI11_3_union",
  "MOI13_union",
  "high_moi_merged_union"
)

category_order <- c(
  "High H3K27ac",
  "H3K27ac",
  "No H3K27ac",
  "CTCF element",
  "H3K27me3 element",
  "Other"
)

color_values <- c("#c5373d", "#d9694a", "#c5cad7", "#49bcbc", "#429130", "grey80")
color_map <- setNames(color_values, category_order)

tile_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    significant = coalesce(significant, FALSE),
    source = factor(source, levels = source_order),
    element_category = factor(element_category, levels = category_order)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38,
    element_category,
    source
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    significant = any(significant),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38,
    source = factor(source_order, levels = source_order),
    fill = list(significant = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    plot_df %>%
      distinct(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, element_category),
    by = "element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38",
    suffix = c("", ".orig")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    element_category = coalesce(element_category, element_category.orig),
    element_category = factor(element_category, levels = category_order)
  ) %>%
  select(-element_category.orig)


pair_order <- tile_df %>%
  distinct(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, element_category) %>%
  arrange(element_category, element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38) %>%
  pull(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38)

tile_df <- tile_df %>%
  mutate(
    element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 = factor(
      element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38,
      levels = rev(pair_order)
    )
  )
ggplot(tile_df,
       aes(x = source,
           y = element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = element_category),
            color = "white",
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    data = tile_df %>% filter(significant),
    aes(x = source, y = element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "black",
    color = "black",
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "DC-TAP paper results validation",
    x = "Source",
    y = "Element-gene pair",
    fill = "Element category"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

```

# Pheatmap of pair significance across union runs

```{r}
source_order_heat <- c(
  "MOI1_1_union",
  "MOI1_5_union",
  "low_moi_merged_union",
  "MOI11_3_union",
  "MOI13_union",
  "high_moi_merged_union"
)

power_cols <- c(
  "power_at_effect_size_2_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_3_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_5_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_10_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_15_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_20_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_25_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_50_wo_pos_controls_20fdr"
)

power_col_labels <- c(
  "power_es_2",
  "power_es_3",
  "power_es_5",
  "power_es_10",
  "power_es_15",
  "power_es_20",
  "power_es_25",
  "power_es_50"
)

power_ann <- table_s3_wtc11 %>%
  select(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, all_of(power_cols)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(power_cols),
      ~ case_when(
        is.na(.) ~ "NA",
        . < 0.5 ~ "<0.5",
        . < 0.8 ~ "0.5-0.8",
        TRUE ~ ">=0.8"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(power_cols), ~ factor(., levels = c("<0.5", "0.5-0.8", ">=0.8", "NA"))))

heat_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    significant = ifelse(is.na(significant), 0L, as.integer(significant)),
    source = factor(source, levels = source_order_heat)
  ) %>%
  select(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, source, significant) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  complete(
    element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38,
    source = factor(source_order_heat, levels = source_order_heat),
    fill = list(significant = 0L)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = significant)

heat_mat <- as.matrix(heat_df[, -1])
rownames(heat_mat) <- heat_df$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38

row_anno <- plot_df %>%
  distinct(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, element_category, pct_change_effect_size.y) %>%
  left_join(
    power_ann,
    by = c("element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38" = "element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    element_category = ifelse(is.na(element_category), "Other", element_category),
    element_category = factor(element_category, levels = category_order),
    pct_change_effect_size = as.numeric(pct_change_effect_size.y)
  )

row_order <- row_anno %>%
  arrange(element_category, desc(pct_change_effect_size), element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38) %>%
  pull(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38)

row_anno_df <- as.data.frame(row_anno)
rownames(row_anno_df) <- row_anno_df$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38
row_anno_df <- row_anno_df[row_order, c("element_category", "pct_change_effect_size", power_cols)]
colnames(row_anno_df) <- c("element_category", "pct_change_effect_size", power_col_labels)

heat_mat <- heat_mat[row_order, source_order_heat, drop = FALSE]

col_anno <- data.frame(
  MOI = c("Low MOI", "Low MOI", "Low MOI", "High MOI", "High MOI", "High MOI"),
  row.names = source_order_heat
)

power_bin_colors <- c(
  "<0.5" = "#d73027",
  "0.5-0.8" = "#fdae61",
  ">=0.8" = "#1a9850",
  "NA" = "grey90"
)

annotation_colors <- list(
  element_category = color_map,
  MOI = c("Low MOI" = "#4E79A7", "High MOI" = "#F28E2B"),
  pct_change_effect_size = colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))(100)
)
for (pc in power_col_labels) {
  annotation_colors[[pc]] <- power_bin_colors
}

pheatmap(
  mat = heat_mat,
  color = c("white", "black"),
  breaks = c(-0.01, 0.5, 1.01),
  legend_breaks = c(0, 1),
  legend_labels = c("Not significant", "Significant"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  annotation_row = row_anno_df,
  annotation_col = col_anno,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  annotation_legend = TRUE,
  main = "Validation pairs across union analyses (significant = black)"
)
```

# Summary statistics for validation

## Percentage of pairs significant in each sample (out of 34)

```{r}
# Set display labels for samples
source_order <- c(
  "MOI1_1_union",
  "MOI1_5_union",
  "low_moi_merged_union",
  "MOI11_3_union",
  "MOI13_union",
  "high_moi_merged_union"
)
source_labels <- c(
  "low_1",
  "low_2",
  "low_merged",
  "high_1",
  "high_2",
  "high_merged"
)

num_pairs <- nrow(heat_mat)
percent_sig_per_sample <- colSums(heat_mat) / num_pairs * 100
summary_sig_per_sample <- data.frame(
  Sample = factor(colnames(heat_mat), levels = source_order, labels = source_labels),
  Num_Significant = colSums(heat_mat),
  Percent_Significant = round(percent_sig_per_sample, 1)
)
summary_sig_per_sample <- summary_sig_per_sample[order(summary_sig_per_sample$Sample), ]
knitr::kable(summary_sig_per_sample, caption = "Significant pairs per sample (out of 34)")
```

## Percentage of pairs per element_category validated in each sample

```{r}
# Set desired orders and display labels
source_order <- c(
  "MOI1_1_union",
  "MOI1_5_union",
  "low_moi_merged_union",
  "MOI11_3_union",
  "MOI13_union",
  "high_moi_merged_union"
)
source_labels <- c(
  "low_1",
  "low_2",
  "low_merged",
  "high_1",
  "high_2",
  "high_merged"
)
category_order <- c(
  "High H3K27ac",
  "H3K27ac",
  "No H3K27ac",
  "CTCF element",
  "H3K27me3 element",
  "Other"
)

row_anno_df$element_category <- as.character(row_anno_df$element_category)
category_sample_stats <- lapply(unique(row_anno_df$element_category), function(cat) {
  idx <- which(row_anno_df$element_category == cat)
  n_cat <- length(idx)
  if (n_cat == 0) return(NULL)
  sig_mat <- heat_mat[idx, , drop=FALSE]
  data.frame(
    element_category = cat,
    Sample = colnames(heat_mat),
    Num_Significant = colSums(sig_mat),
    Percent_Significant = round(colSums(sig_mat) / n_cat * 100, 1),
    Num_Pairs = n_cat
  )
})
category_sample_stats_df <- do.call(rbind, category_sample_stats)

# Apply factor levels for correct ordering
category_sample_stats_df$element_category <- factor(category_sample_stats_df$element_category, levels = category_order)
category_sample_stats_df$Sample <- factor(category_sample_stats_df$Sample, levels = source_order, labels = source_labels)
category_sample_stats_df <- category_sample_stats_df[order(category_sample_stats_df$element_category, category_sample_stats_df$Sample), ]

knitr::kable(category_sample_stats_df, caption = "Significant pairs per element_category per sample (ordered by category and source)")
```

### Plot: Validation rates by element category and sample

```{r}
# Prepare plotting data
plot_data <- category_sample_stats_df
plot_data$MOI <- ifelse(grepl("^low", plot_data$Sample), "Low", "High")
plot_data$Merged <- ifelse(grepl("merged", plot_data$Sample), "Merged", "Not merged")
plot_data$MOI <- factor(plot_data$MOI, levels = c("Low", "High"))
plot_data$Merged <- factor(plot_data$Merged, levels = c("Not merged", "Merged"))

# Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = element_category, y = Percent_Significant, color = MOI, shape = Merged)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#4E79A7", "High" = "#F28E2B")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Not merged" = 16, "Merged" = 17)) +
  labs(
    title = "% of pairs significant per element_category and sample",
    x = "Element Category",
    y = "% Significant",
    color = "MOI",
    shape = "Sample Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Percentage per category validated at least once

```{r}
category_once_stats <- lapply(unique(row_anno_df$element_category), function(cat) {
  idx <- which(row_anno_df$element_category == cat)
  n_cat <- length(idx)
  if (n_cat == 0) return(NULL)
  sig_any <- rowSums(heat_mat[idx, , drop=FALSE]) > 0
  data.frame(
    element_category = cat,
    Num_Validated_At_Least_Once = sum(sig_any),
    Percent_Validated_At_Least_Once = round(sum(sig_any) / n_cat * 100, 1),
    Num_Pairs = n_cat
  )
})
category_once_stats_df <- do.call(rbind, category_once_stats)
knitr::kable(category_once_stats_df, caption = "Pairs per element_category validated at least once across all samples")
```
